headline: KENDRICK KEPT HIS PROMISE
body: Seven-year-old Romell Frazier Jr. asked to meet his favorite rapper while recovering from a life-changing dog attack. Kendrick called on his birthday, invited Romell and his family to Los Angeles — and followed through.
caption:
Seven-year-old Romell Frazier Jr. asked to meet his favorite rapper while recovering from a life-changing dog attack. Kendrick called on his birthday, invited Romell and his family to Los Angeles — and followed through.

Romell's birthday wish reached Kendrick Lamar after the Detroit child returned home from a lengthy hospital stay. Kendrick first surprised him with a video call on July 31, then brought Romell and his family to Los Angeles for their first visit.

Sources: Complex and AllHipHop, Aug. 28, 2026. Original editorial illustration by RapWire 24/7.
